text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's our second summer camp, and Seiun Sky's motivation is at an all time low. But King Halo comes around to drag her along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hope this lack of enthusiasm is just a performance like always. Our summer camp begins with my unease fully intact.
